stem.text: The graph shows how the velocity $v$ of an object moving in a straight line varies with time $t$ from $t = 0$ to $t = T$.

stem.alt: Velocity against time graph: a curve starting at the origin, rising to a positive maximum, crossing zero at mid-time, falling to a negative minimum, and returning to zero at t = T

stem.text: Which graph represents the displacement $s$ of the object in the time $t = 0$ to $t = T$?

A.alt: Displacement against time graph: a single smooth hump above zero, starting and ending at zero at t = T

B.alt: Displacement against time graph: rises to a positive maximum, falls to a negative minimum, and returns to zero at t = T

C.alt: Displacement against time graph: two arches above zero meeting at a sharp point on the time axis, returning to zero at t = T

D.alt: Displacement against time graph: two rounded arches above zero joined by a rounded trough touching zero, returning to zero at t = T
